name: Dwarf
description: Dwarves were raised from the earth by gods of the forge. Their affinity for stone and metal is matched by mountain-like resilience, and their lives can span about 350 years.

grants.name: Darkvision
grants.description: You have Darkvision out to 120 feet.

grants.name: Dwarven Resilience
grants.description: You resist Poison damage and have Advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

grants.name: Dwarven Toughness
grants.description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1 now and by 1 whenever you gain a level.

grants.name: Stonecunning
grants.description: As a Bonus Action while touching a natural or worked stone surface, gain Tremorsense out to 60 feet for 10 minutes. You can do this a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.
